people.name: Caesarea
people.line: Coastal city, center of Roman rule in Judea

people.name: Cyprus
people.line: Island in the Mediterranean Sea; early Christian community

people.name: Mnason
people.line: A Cypriot disciple who hosted Paul in Jerusalem.

translations.web: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
translations.bsb: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us, and they took us to stay at the home of Mnason the Cypriot, an early disciple.
translations.kjv: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
translations.asv: And there went with us also certain of the disciples from Caesarea, bringing with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we should lodge.
